crossRefs.note: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
Jerusalem, that is built as a city that is compact together,
where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.
you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
translations.bsb: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
translations.kjv: In the courts of the LORD'S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
translations.asv: In the courts of Jehovah's house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
